# PART 3 – Reproduction and exploration {#part-3-reproduction-and-exploration .darkslide background-color="rgba(0,0,0,0)"}

::: {.partlabel}
Part 3 – 90 minutes
:::

::: notes
Welcome back. This is the coding-heavy part. The first two parts were mostly concepts, and now we put them to work. You reproduce the value that Multi100 recorded for one of the five analysts, from the very file that the analysts received, and then find out what that number depends on: the model, or the file. Then we open the menu of choices that any analyst of this claim faces, go through what the main ones do to the model, and you spend the last stretch working the menu yourself. By the end of it you will have a feel for which of those choices move the estimate and which barely touch it, and on this claim the answer is unusually clear.
:::
